rules: FCVT.W.D converts a double-precision floating-point number in floating-point register rs1 to a signed 32-bit integer in integer register rd.
FCVT.W.D rounds the result according to the rm field.
If XLEN > 32, FCVT.W.D sign-extends the 32-bit result to the destination register width.
If the rounded result of FCVT.W.D is not representable in the destination format, the result is clipped to the nearest value and the invalid flag is set.
If the rounded result of FCVT.W.D is an out-of-range negative input, the output is -2^31.
If the rounded result of FCVT.W.D is -∞, the output is -2^31.
If the rounded result of FCVT.W.D is an out-of-range positive input, the output is 2^31 - 1.
If the rounded result of FCVT.W.D is +∞ or NaN, the output is 2^31 - 1.
FCVT.W.D sets the Inexact exception flag if the rounded result differs from the operand value and the Invalid exception flag is not set.
If the input operand for FCVT.W.D is a narrower n-bit value (n < FLEN), FCVT.W.D treats the input as an n-bit canonical NaN if the upper FLEN-n bits are not all 1s.
If the input operand for FCVT.W.D is a narrower n-bit value (n < FLEN) and the upper FLEN-n bits are all 1s, FCVT.W.D uses the n least-significant bits as the input value.
